TEXT: Every day was an exciting day after that.
After that argument, I went to buy a new tablet and it took me quite some time.
The tablet was unexpectedly expensive... I certainly couldn't buy it on the spot.
In the end, I withdrew my savings and bought it. Although Kuroneko accepted it reluctantly... this is still a man's way.
And after returning to work... I've experienced "Crunch Time" for the very first time.
Crunch time will truly change a person, that's evident right in front of me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Predicaments will only go towards those who pit themselves against obstacles. Those who don't will only be lambs that follow fate. Then how about the

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: challenger? Will he give in or overcome it?
After muttering to the monitor, Kuroneko's hands moved at a frightening speed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ku-Kuroneko...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Don't talk to me or it'll affect my concentration.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: B-But... are you all right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Better than ever. If I really focus, I'll turn into this state. There's nothing strange about it, so just carry on with your work.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-I see. I got it...
That's actually rather frightening...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Despair only comes to those who give up. Groveling on the ground as they beg for forgiveness in front of God. Can any wall be scaled so long as you do not

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: give up? Will prayers always reach heaven?
Kuroneko isn't going to rest. Even though I'm more focused than before, I'm already reaching my limits.
Ku-Kuroneko-san, this is getting really hard...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: To struggle forward for this knowledge, not giving up even should your feet stop moving. Only those with the resolve to continue no matter what will be

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: allowed to reach this plane...
Even if it's past the limit, work still continues...
Ahh, this isn't what humans do... However, that's why this is being called the 'scene of carnage'.
After all, 'creators' aren't ordinary human beings...
Unknowingly, as the deadline approaches, the momentum increases along with it. I clearly felt that she was different from me.
Well, I'm next to Kuroneko, so I got through this with perseverance.
Even though that's what I thought...
We're finally on the way back home after finishing up everything.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Be that as it may, I didn't think you would personally bring it to the printing office...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Normally you just need to send the data over and be done with it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Though since we're planning on offset printing, it's pointless not to go there directly. Texture of the paper is something you need to actually feel.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, data alone won't do for something like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Yes, printing is one of the pleasures of creating a book.
Offset printing - Simply put, there's two ways of printing doujin. Either use cheap paper to make an ordinary book, or add some money to make it all
shiny.
Giving your book authenticity by putting money in it is what offset is for. Source: Kuroneko-sensei on Doujin Production.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see... But with this, we're all done, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Yes, we have submitted the script for publication. All we have to do now is wait. Well, it's actually the books who'll be waiting for us on that day.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Is that right? So it's over for the time being, well done.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Yes... Well done. Thanks to you, I'm able to finish on time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Haha... I don't know if I was helping you or just slowing you down though...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hmph, I wonder? Which was it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey hey, aren't you supposed to say something like 'It's because you're around, that's why I kept at it'?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...D-Don't get too conceited. To begin with, wasn't it because of your stubbornness that disrupted my momentum?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Wha-, are you blaming that on me? Besides that, isn't the real reason being your own misunderstandings?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: *laugh*

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: *laugh*

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Let's stop here. It's inelegant to continue arguing under such a formal occasion.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What do you mean by a formal occasion?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Isn't that obvious? It's the day we both completed the manuscript.
